title: PIVOT: Bridging Planning and Execution in LLM Agents via Trajectory Refinement
abstract: arXiv:2605.11225v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language model (LLM)-based agents frequently generate seemingly coherent plans that fail upon execution due to infeasible actions, constraint violations, and compounding errors over extended horizons. PIVOT (Plan-Inspect-eVOlve Trajectories) addresses this plan-execution misalignment through a self-supervised framework that treats trajectories as optimizable objects iteratively refined via environment interaction. The framework comprises four stages: PLAN generates candidate trajectories; INSPECT executes them and computes structured losses with textual gradients encoding plan-execution discrepancies; EVOLVE applies these signals to produce improved trajectories; and VERIFY performs a final global check against task constraints. A monotonic acceptance process ensures a non-decreasing solution quality. Empirical evaluations on DeepPlanning and GAIA demonstrate state-of-the-art performance: with human-in-the-loop (HITL) feedback,

translated_title: PIVOT：通过轨迹细化弥合LLM智能体中规划与执行之间的鸿沟
translated_abstract: arXiv:2605.11225v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体经常生成看似连贯的计划，但在执行时却因动作不可行、违反约束以及在较长时间跨度上的误差累积而失败。PIVOT（Plan-Inspect-eVOlve Trajectories，计划-检查-演化轨迹）通过一个自监督框架来解决这种规划与执行的错位问题，该框架将轨迹视为可优化的对象，并通过与环境交互对其进行迭代细化。该框架包含四个阶段：PLAN（计划）生成候选轨迹；INSPECT（检查）执行这些轨迹并计算结构化损失，其中的文本梯度编码了计划与执行之间的差异；EVOLVE（演化）应用这些信号以生成改进后的轨迹；VERIFY（验证）则针对任务约束执行最终的全局检查。单调接受过程确保了解决方案质量不会下降。在DeepPlanning和GAIA上的实证评估展示了最先进的性能：在人在环（HITL）反馈下，
tldr: PIVOT提出了一种自监督框架，通过计划、检查、演化、验证四个阶段将轨迹作为可优化对象进行迭代细化，利用文本梯度编码规划与执行的差异，从而弥合LLM智能体中规划与执行之间的鸿沟，并在DeepPlanning和GAIA基准上取得最先进的性能。
en_tdlr: PIVOT introduces a self-supervised framework that treats trajectories as optimizable objects, iteratively refined through Plan, Inspect, Evolve, and Verify stages using textual gradients to encode plan-execution discrepancies, bridging the gap between planning and execution in LLM agents and achieving state-of-the-art performance on DeepPlanning and GAIA benchmarks.
